id.title: Post's identifier as a LinkedIn URN

publishedAt.title: Publish time as milliseconds from unix epoch

media.title: Post's media, resolved to URLs a display can use directly

type.title: Kind of media the post carries
type.description: A LinkedIn post carries exactly one kind of media. "image": a single still. "carousel": several stills posted as one item. "video": a directly playable video. "document": a PDF or slide deck, pre-rendered by LinkedIn as one image per page. "article": a link share, for which only a preview image exists. "none": a text-only post, or a post whose media could not be resolved.

images.title: Ordered still images
images.description: The single image, the carousel frames, or the document's pages in page order. Empty for "video" and "none".

video.title: URI to a directly playable video, null unless type is "video"
video.description: A progressive stream (normally MP4) served publicly by LinkedIn, so a display can play it without caching or a streaming library.

thumbnail.title: Poster still for "video", preview image for "article", otherwise null

error.title: Latest error message, null when the last fetch succeeded

dateFormat.title: Date format chosen for the source

textMode.title: How displays should handle long post text
textMode.description: "cut": clamp the text. "entire": shrink it until the whole post fits.
